page: Bearer token plugin for Elysia. RFC6750 compliant Bearer token retrieval. Installation with bun add @elysia/bearer. bearer() plugin integration. Token extraction from Authorization header. HTTP 400 response with WWW-Authenticate header on missing token. Bearer realm parameter. Does NOT validate authentication, leaves validation to developers. Set.headers['WWW-Authenticate'] pattern. Bearer realm='sign' error="invalid_request" format. Questions: How do I extract Bearer tokens? What does this plugin do and not do? How do I set up Bearer token handling?
